email_body:
Dear Mutomobility team,

I'm applying for the Performance Marketing Specialist role. Your vision of simplifying corporate mobility through a data-driven platform resonates with me, and I'd love to contribute my digital marketing and analytical skills to help Muto grow internationally.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've planned and optimized campaigns, run A/B tests on landing pages, and analyzed performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. I've also built and optimized websites with WordPress and Shopify, improving conversion funnels and technical SEO. My background in front-end development gives me a hands-on edge in collaborating with creative colleagues and implementing data-driven improvements.

While my Dutch is currently at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, I'm actively improving and am committed to reaching fluency. I'm fluent in English and bring a strong analytical mindset, project management skills, and a passion for full-funnel strategies.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Muto achieve its performance marketing goals.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Mutomobility team,

I'm writing to apply for the Performance Marketing Specialist position. Muto's mission to simplify corporate mobility through a single data-driven platform stands out to me, and I'm excited by the opportunity to bring my performance marketing and analytical skills to a team that's shaping the future of mobility.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've gained hands-on experience in planning and optimizing paid campaigns, setting up A/B tests for landing pages and ads, and analyzing campaign performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads. I've also built and optimized websites in WordPress and Shopify, improving conversion funnels and technical SEO health. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) allows me to collaborate effectively with creative and technical colleagues to implement data-driven improvements.

I have a strong analytical mindset and a knack for turning data into growth opportunities. I'm fluent in English and comfortable working in hybrid settings. While my Dutch is currently at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, I'm actively improving and am committed to reaching the fluency required for this role. I'm a team player with excellent project management skills and a passion for full-funnel strategies, and I'm eager to contribute to Muto's international success.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my experience and enthusiasm can help Muto achieve its performance marketing goals. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
